title: OnboardingInput
description: Declarative input for provider onboarding (M3 T6.0). Twin of OnboardingInput in packages/types/src/onboarding.ts. Committed to git, so it has no key field and rejects unknown properties. Three checks are TypeScript-only because JSON Schema cannot express them: a future valuationTs, providerWallet == token, and the exact uint256 ceiling inside the 78-digit band. Duplicate JSON keys are invisible to every validator; git review is the only defence.

assetId.description: Lowercase alphanumeric words joined by single hyphens, at most 32 characters.

description.description: Must contain at least one character outside Unicode Cc, Cf, Zs, Zl and Zp. ECMA-262 pattern with Unicode property escapes: a non-JS validator may not support \p{...}.

grossWeight.description: Gross bar weight in grams, 18-decimal fixed point.

fineness.description: Parts per 10,000; 999.9 fine = 9999. intendedSupply must equal grossWeight * fineness / 10000 (checked by the script).

source.description: Must contain at least one character outside Unicode Cc, Cf, Zs, Zl and Zp. ECMA-262 pattern with Unicode property escapes: a non-JS validator may not support \p{...}.

currency.description: Three uppercase letters. Not checked against the ISO 4217 register; the provider confirms it at onboarding.

unitValue.description: Price per FINE gram (ADR 0020), 18-decimal fixed point.

valuationTs.description: Unix seconds. Must not be in the future; enforced by the TypeScript validator, which JSON Schema cannot express.

custodianId.description: Must contain at least one character outside Unicode Cc, Cf, Zs, Zl and Zp. ECMA-262 pattern with Unicode property escapes: a non-JS validator may not support \p{...}.

intendedSupply.description: Tokens to mint, in FINE grams (ADR 0020), 18-decimal fixed point.

attestations.description: Array from day one for Q11 forward-compatibility. MS1's exactly-one rule is enforced by the script, not here.

path.description: CBOR envelope on disk, relative to contracts/ (the script's form). Never absolute, never a '..' segment.

bytesBase64.description: CBOR envelope inline, standard base64 (the console's form).

providerWallet.description: The provider who owns the metal and receives the initial mint (C2). Must not equal token (TypeScript-only check).

address.description: 0x-prefixed 20-byte hex address, not the zero address. EIP-55 checksum is enforced by the script and console (AC-20), not here.

positiveUint256String.description: Positive base-10 integer string, never a JSON number. maxLength 78 is the length of 2^256 - 1; the exact ceiling is TypeScript-only, so the two validators differ only on 78-digit values between 2^256 - 1 and 10^78 - 1.
